start_record.expected_result: Allow direct browser access from the explicitly configured Tailnet origin without a site-key prompt while retaining sessions, CSRF, WebSocket authorization and exact-origin enforcement.

observations.scope_boundary: This task changes only browser access policy. It does not configure or switch Codex accounts, test continuity, expose port 8214 publicly, or weaken unsafe-request and WebSocket checks.

residual_risks: Every device allowed by Tailnet ACLs to reach port 8214 will have high-privilege workspace access.
One real account remains configured, so automatic account switching remains untested.
M6.2 remains rejected under the user-directed soak exception.
